title: RE Services Personal Trading in Non-Perpetual Securities Policy

tiers.name: RE Services staff
tiers.description: All staff within the RE Services business unit of the Perpetual Entities, the outsourced Responsible Entity that administers schemes including this Fund (whose securities are 'non-Perpetual securities' from RE Services' perspective). Must pre-clear all personal trading in non-Perpetual securities through MCO before executing a trade. Not included in the separate Group Policy's definition of 'Restricted Employees'.

tiers.name: Business Unit Head
tiers.description: Head of the RE Services business unit; unlike other RE Services staff, whose trades are approved by the Business Unit Head, the Business Unit Head's own trades must be approved by the General Manager, Managed Fund Services (or delegate).

windows.end_anchor: 3 days after the release of financial statements to members

windows.start_anchor: identification/reporting to a Perpetual Entity of a potential disclosing event
windows.end_anchor: resolution of the event and/or disclosure of the event to members

windows.start_anchor: date of awareness of particular scheme amendments
windows.end_anchor: the scheme amendment has been implemented and/or reported to members

rules.detail: Derivatives are never mentioned. The Policy only regulates 'trading' in non-Perpetual securities generally and refers staff to a separate Group Policy for further detail, which is not included in this document.
No hedging provision or definition of any kind appears in the document.
Granting security or a charge over securities is not mentioned.
Secured financing arrangements of any kind are not mentioned.

A minimum three-month holding period applies before a position in a non-Perpetual security (which would include this Fund's units) may be redeemed/disposed of; the Policy frames this under 'Redemptions' and does not clarify whether it extends to on-market sales of ASX-quoted units.
rules.evidence: Redemptions: Position must be held for at least three months.

clearance.evidence: all RE Services staff (excluding the Business Head) must be approved through MCO by the Business Unit Head or their delegate; ... Approval granted pursuant to this Policy is valid for that business day only.

bespoke_clauses.clause: This Policy applies to all staff within the RE Services business unit and governs all personal trading by RE Services staff in schemes administered by the RE Services business unit ("non-Perpetual securities").
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: The document governs only the outsourced Responsible Entity's administrative staff dealing in the Fund's units; it never mentions the Fund's own directors, the investment manager's personnel, or any equity/incentive arrangement, so it is unclear this is the operative trading policy for the population a bank would target for a director/executive funded collar.

bespoke_clauses.topic: no derivatives, hedging or financing coverage
bespoke_clauses.clause: RE Services staff ... are within the scope of the definition of non-Perpetual Securities: (a) Prohibition of Insider Trading (b) Prohibition on front running (c) Prohibition on procuring or encouraging third parties to trade (d) Conflicts of interest (e) High volume personal trading.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: None of derivatives, hedging, margin lending, encumbrance, short selling, stock lending or CFDs are named anywhere; the substantive content sits in the separate Group Policy referenced but not included, so no leg of a funded collar can be confirmed as permitted or prohibited from this document alone.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Approval granted pursuant to this Policy is valid for that business day only. Where the RE Services staff member has failed to act on that approval, a new approval must be sought to trade on another business day. ... Any trades submitted after 12 noon will be denied.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: If a collar or its unwind is treated as 'trading' under this Policy, each leg would need fresh same-business-day approval, which is operationally awkward for a multi-leg OTC structure with a bank counterparty.

bespoke_clauses.clause: This Policy will be reviewed at least every two years and updated as required from time to time.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: No date of adoption, approval or lodgement appears anywhere in the document, so its currency and ASX Listing Rule 12.10 status cannot be confirmed from the text alone.

summary: This document is not a conventional director/executive securities trading policy for KKR Credit Income Fund; it is the personal trading policy of RE Services, the business unit of the Fund's outsourced Responsible Entity (Perpetual), governing that unit's own staff dealing in 'non-Perpetual securities' including the Fund's units. It contains no reference to derivatives, hedging, margin lending, encumbrance, short selling, stock lending or CFDs, so none of the legs of a funded OTC equity collar are expressly addressed, permitted or prohibited; the only substantive provisions are a same-business-day pre-approval requirement via MCO, three defined non-trading periods tied to results, disclosing events and scheme amendments, and a three-month minimum holding period on redemptions. The Policy never mentions the Fund's directors, the investment manager's staff, or any equity incentive arrangement, and relies for its substantive insider trading, front-running and conflicts provisions on a separate Group Policy that is not included in this document. On the face of this document alone a funded collar is neither expressly permitted nor prohibited; a bank would need to obtain and review the referenced Group Policy and confirm which policy actually governs KKC's directors and the investment manager's personnel before concluding a collar is available.
